name: delete_message
title: Delete message
description: Delete one message. It is moved to Trash when possible, and deleted permanently when it already is in Trash.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

force.description: Delete message even if not in Trash. Not supported for Gmail API accounts.

name: get_account
title: Get account
description: Get one account: its display name, email address, connection state and sync status. Credentials are masked.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

quota.description: If true, then include quota information in the response

name: get_attachment
title: Get attachment
description: Download one attachment, returned inline as a base64 resource. The attachment id comes from the attachments list of get_message. Fails above 1 MB - larger files have to be fetched over the REST API.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

name: get_message
title: Get message
description: Get one message: subject, addresses, date, flags, attachment list and the body. The body arrives in text.html as sanitized HTML, generated from the plaintext part when the message carries no HTML one, with no separate plaintext copy. It is capped at 65536 bytes - text.hasMore true means the rest is available from get_message_text. Quoted reply and forward history is wrapped in a <details class="ee-collapsed-thread"> element - what an email client hides behind a "show more" control - so everything outside it is what the sender wrote this time.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

markAsSeen.description: If true, then marks unseen email as seen while returning the message

name: get_message_text
title: Get message text
description: Fetch the body of a message as sanitized HTML, generated from the plaintext part when the message carries no HTML one. The text id comes from the text.id field of get_message or list_messages. Quoted reply and forward history is wrapped in a <details class="ee-collapsed-thread"> element - what an email client hides behind a "show more" control - so everything outside it is what the sender wrote this time.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

maxBytes.description: Max length of text content. Ignored for Gmail API and MS Graph API accounts (full content is always returned)

name: get_outbox
title: List outbox
description: List messages queued for delivery, paged, including scheduled sends and their delivery progress.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: list_accounts
title: List accounts
description: List the email accounts on this instance, paged. Use the returned account id as the account argument of the other tools. Check the state field: only connected accounts can be read.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: list_mailboxes
title: List mailboxes
description: List the folders of an account with message counts and special-use roles (Inbox, Sent, Trash and so on). Folder paths from here are what list_messages, search_messages and move_message take.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

counters.description: If true, then includes message counters in the response

name: list_messages
title: List messages
description: List messages in one mailbox folder, newest first, paged. The folder path comes from list_mailboxes.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

path.description: Mailbox folder path. Can use special use labels like "\Sent". Special value "\All" is available for Gmail IMAP, Gmail API, MS Graph API accounts.

page.description: Page number (zero-indexed, so use 0 for the first page). Only supported for IMAP accounts

name: list_templates
title: List templates
description: List stored email templates, paged. Pass an account id for account-specific templates or omit it for shared ones.

account.description: Account ID to list the templates for

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: move_message
title: Move message
description: Move one message to another folder. The target folder path comes from list_mailboxes.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

source.description: Source mailbox folder path (Gmail API only). Needed to remove the label from the message.

name: search_messages
title: Search messages
description: Search for messages in one folder using structured criteria (from, to, subject, body, date ranges, flags). Searches a single folder, not the whole account.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

page.description: Page number (zero-indexed, so use 0 for the first page). Only supported for IMAP accounts

useOutlookSearch.description: MS Graph only. Use the $search parameter for search queries instead of $filter

path.description: Mailbox folder path. Can use special use labels like "\Sent". Special value "\All" is available for Gmail IMAP, Gmail API, MS Graph API accounts.

seq.description: Sequence number range (e.g., "1:10" or "1,3,5"). Only supported for IMAP.

answered.description: Filter for messages that have been replied to. Only supported for IMAP.

deleted.description: Filter for messages marked for deletion. Only supported for IMAP.

to.description: Search in To addresses. Not supported for MS Graph API.

cc.description: Search in Cc addresses. Not supported for MS Graph API.

bcc.description: Search in Bcc addresses. Not supported for MS Graph API.

larger.description: Find messages larger than specified size in bytes. Not supported for MS Graph API.

smaller.description: Find messages smaller than specified size in bytes. Not supported for MS Graph API.

uid.description: UID range (e.g., "100:200" or "150,200,250"). Only supported for IMAP.

modseq.description: Find messages with modification sequence higher than specified value. Only supported for IMAP with CONDSTORE.

before.description: Find messages received before this date

since.description: Find messages received after this date

sentBefore.description: Find messages sent before this date

sentSince.description: Find messages sent after this date

emailId.description: Globally unique email identifier (when supported by the email server)

threadId.description: Thread identifier for email conversations (when supported by the email server)

gmailRaw.description: Gmail search syntax (only works with Gmail accounts)

labels.description: Filter by Gmail labels or MS Graph (Outlook) categories. Not supported for generic IMAP accounts.

has.description: Match messages that contain ALL of these labels/categories. Supported for Gmail and MS Graph (Outlook) accounts only.

not.description: Match messages that contain NONE of these labels/categories. Supported for Gmail and MS Graph (Outlook) accounts only.

emailIds.description: List of specific email IDs to fetch

items.description: Globally unique email identifier (when supported by the email server)
